scope: Analytic placement diagnostic only, no candidate verdict or native canonical render. Ignores multisample coverage, denoising, lighting/secondary radiance and transparent body materials; body is opaque in inspected source.

records.method: Read-only geometric camera-ray visibility against evaluated opaque chef/knife meshes, source food plane depth unchanged; image alpha bilinear sampled at native pixel centers. Canonical quad computed mathematically only, never added/saved/rendered as candidate.
